newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE bunkers firm in active market.
newsitem.headline: NWE bunkers firm in active market.

text.p: Bunker prices in northwest Europe firmed on Tuesday with demand high for the second consecutive day, while prices in the south were steady, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was about $1 a tonne higher at $86/$87 fob. Barges similarly firmed by about $1. Traders said the strength was the result of a second day of healthy demand, including a number of enquiries of 2,000 tonnes and above.
Most suppliers questioned said traded volume topped 20,000 tonnes in the entire ARA region.
"We expect some buyers are also holding back other enquiries," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices were similarly higher amid healthy demand. Deals for 380 CST were concluded at around $91 delivered.
In the Mediterranean, however, prices were broadly flat and trading very quiet.
